payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (removal PR, branch claude/remove-ward-flow-caring-contacts-ltxdgk; offline, no provider access): Caring Contacts was retired and deleted on 2026-09-26 by the removal PR, so it drops out of this item. The other omitted subsystems (CME evidence uploads and the rest listed below) are unchanged and still need the assessment. PRIOR DETAIL: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Still true: docs/privacy-impact-assessment.md has no mention of Caring Contacts, the pocket card, the service worker, the developer hub or site_content. Add a sixth gap: CME private evidence uploads (public.cme_evidence, migration 20260922175023, plus the 2026-09-24 evidence-removal migration). Also correct the line saying On Call compliance rows are cached in localStorage; closed #KJF5J7 stopped that. PRIOR DETAIL: docs/privacy-impact-assessment.md gained an On Call compliance entry (PIA-9) on 2026-09-20, but still does not mention, at all: (1) CARING CONTACTS, a whole patient-data subsystem with its own database (src/lib/caring-contacts/**, src/lib/caring-contacts-server/**, CARING_CONTACTS_DATABASE_URL) -- by far the largest gap and the only patient data in the product; (2) the PRINTED POCKET CARD, the only artefact that physically leaves the app; (3) the SERVICE WORKER caching policy (public/sw.js) and what it retains on the device; (4) the DEVELOPER HUB (src/components/developer-area/**) and what operational data it surfaces; (5) the PUBLIC CATALOGUE surface and its one anon-callable database function, public.read_site_content_public_records, granted to the anon role. Verified absent by grep on 2026-09-20: zero mentions of caring, pocket, service worker, developer hub or site_content anywhere in the document. This is governance documentation rather than an engineering defect -- nothing is leaking -- but the assessment is the artefact an external adviser reads, and as written it understates the data footprint of the product. NEXT ACTION: add one section-2 data-category row per subsystem and, where a residual risk exists, a numbered PIA entry; do Caring Contacts first and do not let the other four hold it up. Escalate the Caring Contacts part to P1 if the production-configuration check finds that workspace enabled in production.
